6a2359bdcfabe43cd45bf727f82ccb0b.overview: A British District Officer in Nigeria in the 1930s rules his area strictly but justly. He struggles with gun-runners and slavers with the aid of a loyal native chief.
6a2359bdcfabe43cd45bf727f82ccb0b.tagline: He Breaks Loose in the Jungle!

6a53334c435fdad0455fbc0917e89c5c.overview: For over 40 years Val Kilmer, one of Hollywood's most mercurial and/or misunderstood actors, has been documenting his own life and craft through film and video. He has amassed thousands of hours of footage, from 16mm home movies made with his brothers, to time spent in iconic roles for blockbuster movies like Top Gun, The Doors, Tombstone, and Batman Forever. This raw, wildly original and unflinching documentary reveals a life lived to extremes and a heart-filled, sometimes hilarious look at what it means to be an artist and a complex man.
6a53334c435fdad0455fbc0917e89c5c.tagline: The life you live is the story you tell.

6a61d674c6c677e2d8fa469208a85696.overview: In occupied Paris, an actress wed to a Jewish theater owner must keep him hidden from the Nazis while doing both of their jobs.
6a61d674c6c677e2d8fa469208a85696.tagline: A story of love and conflict.

6abf3c2f568da7c1d05550c3c67fdfc5.overview: Three generations of the rowdy Cutler family live as outlaws in some of Britain's richest countryside – hunting hares, ram-raiding stately homes, and taunting the police. Struggling to retain a way of life fast becoming extinct, Chad Cutler ends up caught between his father's archaic principles and trying to do right by his kids, whilst the full force of the law is finally catching up with him.

6ac450d094d31cd7e150492633169827.overview: Two gangsters, fighting for influence in the city, decide to get suitcases filled with money and drugs. Meanwhile, another criminal group has the same purpose.

6ac53d0230f5b7a78fd37d9e41832ca3.overview: A small-town girl with a soft spot for American soldiers wakes up the morning after a wild farewell party for the troops to find that she married someone she can't remember.
6ac53d0230f5b7a78fd37d9e41832ca3.tagline: The True Story of TRUDY KOCKENLOCKER, who kissed the Boys Goodbye... REGIMENT BY REGIMENT!

6afb4e7e84969d24703cac084ada9427.overview: As a CODA (Child of Deaf Adults), Ruby is the only hearing person in her deaf family. When the family's fishing business is threatened, Ruby finds herself torn between pursuing her love of music and her fear of abandoning her parents.
6afb4e7e84969d24703cac084ada9427.tagline: Every family has its own language.
